description.value:
Berserk counts as Borgware for your Maximum Humanity and activates for free, for 4 Rounds. Without an FBC or Cyberspine, 1d6 Humanity Loss per activation and −4 to ranged attacks while it runs. While it runs: all HP damage is halved (round up); any of these can be half of a ROF2 Action: grab or drop a shield, get up, Grab, Human Shield, Stabilize yourself, use an object (drugs, Pharmaceuticals), activate gear or chrome, clear a jam, put yourself out, stow a weapon; and Brawling and Martial Arts Aimed Shots work at ROF2. When it ends, recover 5 HP. 1-hour cooldown, or reactivate early for 3 Humanity Loss, then 6, then 9.

Runs: Berserk

Item Compendium (2070) • Cyberware
